# This is the positive aspect of credit cards

- [Start](https://www.eafit.edu.co/)
- [Ongoing](https://www.eafit.edu.co/ongoing)
- [The Know-It-All](https://www.eafit.edu.co/ongoing/sabelotodo)
- These are the positive aspects of credit cards

Used responsibly, credit cards have tons of benefits: they help build your credit history, can give you cashback, miles, insurance, discounts, brand benefits, and the list goes on.

But be aware that there are also many downsides: you can easily get into serious trouble with interest rates. Spoiler alert: The interest rate on almost all credit cards is extremely high. It's known as the usury rate, meaning the maximum interest rate allowed by law.

#### **So, what should you consider before using them?**

1. The first and most important thing is to try to pay everything in one installment whenever possible, that way you save on interest.
2. Know your billing cycle date well and never miss the payment deadline. You don't want to be getting calls demanding payment 24/7.
3. Always keep in mind the rewards or benefits of your card before making each purchase so that you get the most out of it.
4. Be very careful when shopping online. Make sure the websites are secure and avoid giving your card details to anyone via chat or email.
